This article is a stub. Adolph Kiefer & Associates is an American swimming equipment company
whose Kiefer Sports Timing Systems division, then of Northfield, Illinois, was the exclusive
United States agent for Omega Electronics timing from 1988 and advertised the
[OSM6](../equipment/swimming/timers/osm6.md) console.

It took over the Omega agency from [Sportyme](sportyme.md); see the [vendors](index.md)
register for the companies this wiki covers.
